title: SentiGOLD: A Large Bangla Gold Standard Multi-Domain Sentiment Analysis Dataset and its Evaluation
findings: The BanglaBert model achieved a macro F1 score of 0.58 on the 'Religion' domain. A token bias analysis of specific religious terms (e.g., Islam, Allah, Hinduism, God) found that the SentiGOLD dataset does not have significant token bias for these terms.
